Hansen ranks the Skiff among the better transport vehicles for either side: it deploys -1 to Tatooine sites, carries a driver and up to five passengers who all add their power, moves as a react, and lets everyone aboard disembark if it is lost. Dark Side players can add an [[Antipersonnel Laser Cannon]]. He advises carrying mains and other tough characters on Skiffs to guard exterior sites. == What changed on the image ==
[[File:JP-L-skiff-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Skiff (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the previous version. This is a full card image again (350 × 490 pixels), with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 E card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
